note: Supreme Court citations Hoffman's table supplies for register rows whose scotus_cite is blank. STAGED, not applied; data/ranchos-register.* stays byte-identical to the Zenodo v1.0 deposit until v1.1. Each citation is also given in modern U.S. Reports form (Howard volumes 1-24 are U.S. Reports 42-65, so n Howard = (41+n) U.S.). CONFIDENCE: citations are as printed in Hoffman's table and pass a structural check (all in Howard 17-24, the correct range for an 1862 imprint, no anachronistic Wallace citations), but they were NOT verified against the reports themselves: CourtListener returns HTTP 202 with a bot challenge to scripted clients, the same control digicoll uses, and it was not worked around. A human in a browser can confirm any of them in seconds.
source: Hoffman 1862, Appendix, Table of Land Claims, pp. 1-109 (IA GR_1919).
